summaryZh: Bertin Lab 研究慢性炎症与癌症发展的关系，关注炎症小体、肿瘤微环境免疫细胞和长期空气过敏原暴露。实验室采用细胞、分子、生化、免疫学技术和体内小鼠模型。
researchQuestions: 慢性炎症影响癌症发生风险的确切机制是什么？
长期暴露于常见空气过敏原、慢性肺炎症与肺癌发生风险之间有何联系？

evidence.quote: Our lab utilizes various cellular, molecular, biochemical, and immunological techniques as well as murine in vivo models to study human inflammatory diseases and cancer. Current research projects in the lab are focused on chronic inflammation and cancer development, particularly in relation to inflammasome signaling and immune cells in the tumor microenvironment.
chronic exposure to common airborne allergens, chronic lung inflammation, and the risk of developing lung cancer.
Dr. Bertin is now an Assistant Professor in the Department of Medicine at UCSD.

Although the relationship between inflammation and cancer is now widely accepted, the exact mechanisms by which chronic inflammation affects the risk of developing cancer remain unclear. Our lab investigates the link between chronic inflammation and cancer
One of our projects aims to investigate the link between chronic exposure to common airborne allergens, chronic lung inflammation, and the risk of developing lung cancer.
